title: Vipera: Towards systematic auditing of generative text-to-image models at scale

bias_targets.methodology: Users specify 'gender' (e.g., male/female) as an attribute node in a hierarchical scene graph within the Vipera system. The system then uses a Vision-Language Model (LLaVA) to automatically label generated images and visualizes the gender distribution of characters (e.g., for professions like 'doctor') using stacked bar charts and clustered scatterplots.

Evaluated during an observational user study where participants utilized the Vipera visual analytics system to define racial criteria. The system structurally assessed the text-to-image model outputs to observe racial representation and diversity in the generated human characters.
